name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-11-10, at wavelengths from 1.35 to 4.68 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
